geometry.locator: Near point from geometry:fermilab-numi-target (surveyed DUSAF coordinates of the NuMI TDR beam sheet, row HALTA); far point per site:ash-river-nova-far-detector (src:nova-prd-2021-seasonal-multiple-muons, 'located on the surface in Minnesota near the U.S.-Canada Border at (48.4N,92.8W)')
geometry.note: Not a physical structure; drawn and labelled as an inferred direction only. The NuMI beam also served the MINOS far detector at Soudan (1985-2016) on a nearly identical bearing (336.2 degrees vs 335.6 degrees here, both computed from the same near point) -- not drawn separately to avoid clutter. Since 2026-10-25 the near point is the surveyed NuMI target; the line starts exactly where geometry:fermilab-numi-beamline begins.

method: Great-circle bearing (335.6 degrees) from the surveyed NuMI target (geometry:fermilab-numi-target) to the sourced Ash River far-site coordinate (48.4 N, -92.8 E), clipped to the first 3000 m so it stays within the map extent (map extent_m 2500). Haversine/initial-bearing on R=6371008.8 m.
name: NuMI beam direction toward Ash River (NOvA far detector) -- inferred

summary.plain: An inferred direction (great-circle bearing 335.6 degrees) from the NuMI target toward the NOvA far detector at Ash River, Minnesota. It is not a physical structure.
